steps.context: Input is /eval-full-32-without-log-normalized-n6-1/data/inputs/expression/log_expr.csv (12000 x 13, first column presumably gene identifiers, remaining 12 columns are sample log2(TPM+1) values) and /eval-full-32-without-log-normalized-n6-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 x 2: sample ID and condition, treated vs control). Single batch, unpaired design. Data is already normalized and log2-transformed by the core facility — do not re-normalize or re-log-transform.
steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes in log_expr.csv differ significantly in expression between the 6 treated and 6 control muscle samples described in metadata.csv?
constraints: Do not apply DESeq2, edgeR, or pydeseq2 to this matrix — those require raw integer counts and the input is continuous log2 normalized data
Do not re-normalize or apply an additional log transform; use the values as delivered
Verify column-order-to-metadata-row correspondence explicitly rather than assuming file order matches
acceptance_criteria: Sample IDs in log_expr.csv columns are matched and reordered to align exactly with metadata.csv rows before model fitting

limma linear model fit with design ~condition on the log2(TPM+1) matrix (12000 genes x 12 samples), followed by eBayes moderation — no count-based DE tool (DESeq2, edgeR, pydeseq2) is used since data is already normalized log2 values, not counts
Output table reports logFC, moderated t-statistic, raw p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value for all 12000 genes, sorted by adjusted p-value
A PCA or MDS plot of the 12 samples colored by treated/control is produced to visually confirm separation and check for outliers
A p-value histogram is produced to assess whether the test is well-calibrated (uniform under null, enrichment near 0 under signal)
Number of genes passing adj.P.Val < 0.05 and |logFC| > 1 is reported explicitly, even if zero or very few, given the n=6 per arm sample size

steps.name: Pathway enrichment of differentially expressed genes
caveats: With only n=6 per arm, the significant gene list may be small or empty, in which case pre-ranked GSEA on the full ranked list is more informative than a hard-threshold ORA
steps.context: Uses the DE results table from T1S1 (12000 gene logFC/p-values from the treated vs control muscle comparison) together with the WikiPathways human pathway gene sets (HGNC symbols) confirmed present in this environment at /mnt/refs/managed/wikipathways-human/2026.07.10/wikipathways_Homo_sapiens.gmt.
steps.question: Which WikiPathways human pathways are over-represented among genes significantly different between treated and control muscle samples?
constraints: Match gene identifiers in the expression matrix to WikiPathways HGNC gene symbols; report and quantify any identifiers that fail to map rather than silently dropping them
Do not substitute a non-human pathway reference for this human dataset
acceptance_criteria: Enrichment is run on the significant gene set from T1S1 (adj.P.Val < 0.05, |logFC| > 1, or the closest available significance tier if none pass that exact threshold) using WikiPathways human gene sets as the reference

If fewer than ~10 genes reach significance, the step falls back to reporting a pre-ranked GSEA-style analysis on the full logFC-ranked gene list instead of a hard-threshold over-representation test, and states which approach was used
Output lists enriched pathway names (recovered by splitting the '%'-delimited descriptor field), gene set size, overlap count, and BH-adjusted enrichment p-value
Explicitly reports if the WikiPathways human reference file is unavailable at run time and what fallback (if any) was used

plan.title: Muscle treated vs control DE from log2 expression (limma)
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) normalized expression, not raw counts, so count-based tools (DESeq2/edgeR/pydeseq2) are not appropriate — their negative-binomial models require integer counts. limma with an empirical-Bayes moderated t-test on the log2 matrix is the standard, correct approach for pre-normalized continuous expression data. The design is a simple unpaired 6 vs 6 comparison in a single batch, so no batch correction is needed. Step 1 loads the 12000x13 log2 expression matrix and 12x2 metadata, verifies sample-ID alignment between the two files, fits a limma linear model (~condition) with eBayes moderation, and outputs a full differential expression table (logFC, moderated t, p-value, BH-adjusted p-value) for all 12000 genes, plus diagnostic plots (PCA/MDS of the 12 samples colored by condition, and a p-value histogram to check test calibration). Step 2 takes the significant gene list (adj.P.Val < 0.05, |logFC| > 1 as a starting threshold, reported regardless of how many genes pass) and runs over-representation / pathway enrichment against WikiPathways human gene sets, which are confirmed present in this environment, to give biological context to the DE signal. Both steps operate only on this dataset's actual files and thresholds are reported transparently including the case where few or no genes reach significance given the modest n=6/arm sample size.
